name: Debashish Deb
title: Computational Systems Specialist & Full-Stack Engineer
tagline: Bridging molecular biotechnology, computational infrastructure, and modern software engineering. Managing research platforms and CSC supercomputing at Färkkilä Laboratory (University of Helsinki). Open to scholarly collaborations and technical appointments.
about: I am a molecular biotechnologist turned computational systems specialist and software engineer based in Helsinki, Finland. At Färkkilä Laboratory (Biomedicum Helsinki, University of Helsinki), I oversee research databases, digital platforms, and high-performance CSC computing clusters. Dedicated to continuous scholarship and pragmatic engineering, I welcome interdisciplinary collaborations and technical appointments.
aboutExtended:
My academic trajectory commenced in molecular biotechnology, earning a Master of Science degree at the University of Helsinki and co-authoring peer-reviewed oncological investigations in Haematologica and Blood. Conducting high-throughput drug phenotypic screenings and interpreting complex multi-omic data underscored the profound necessity for rigorous, reproducible software architecture in modern life sciences.

Presently, I serve as IT & Systems Specialist at Färkkilä Laboratory (Biomedicum Helsinki, Faculty of Medicine, University of Helsinki), stewarding scientific computing clusters hosted by the Finnish IT Center for Science (CSC), maintaining curated patient specimen registries, and advancing bespoke web portals for precision oncology (ONCOSYS-OVA).

I view software development as a disciplined scholarly craft. Pursuing advanced computational coursework at Kood/Sisu, I engineer performant solutions in Go, TypeScript, React, and Flutter, upholding the zero-defect empirical precision instilled during my industrial tenure in Finnish high-precision manufacturing (ABB and Swappie). I am receptive to selective research collaborations, technical consultations, and professional appointments.

Sub-100ms real-time barcode scanning with auto-focus and offline history storage
